args.query: fetch many URLs concurrently with httpx AsyncClient limited to 5 requests per second using aiolimiter

results.title: aiolimiter AsyncLimiter guarding httpx AsyncClient offline
results.summary: Throttle an httpx AsyncClient with aiolimiter's leaky-bucket AsyncLimiter and test the burst, serialized concurrency, error and event-loop reuse gotchas fully offline with httpx.MockTransport.

results.title: requests-cache CachedSession with sqlite backend and expiry
results.summary: A requests session backed by a persistent sqlite cache with TTL expiry and 200-only caching, tested offline with responses mocks.

results.title: FastAPI lifespan state tested with httpx ASGITransport and asgi-lifespan
results.summary: A FastAPI app that opens a SQLite connection in its lifespan, then test it offline through httpx ASGITransport, with asgi-lifespan running startup and shutdown.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints rate limited with slowapi, tested with TestClient
results.summary: Add per-route and per-API-key rate limits to FastAPI with slowapi, then test 429 behavior offline with TestClient and the in-memory store.

results.title: httpx + tenacity async retries honoring Retry-After, tested with respx
results.summary: Wrap async httpx calls in tenacity AsyncRetrying that retries 429 and 5xx, honors Retry-After, and patches the wait to zero in tests with respx mocks.

results.title: Typed httpx client parsing into pydantic v2 models, tested with respx
results.summary: An async httpx client that retries 5xx and transport errors, validates responses into pydantic v2 models, and is tested offline with respx route mocks.

results.title: httpx OAuth2 client-credentials client with cached tokens and Link pagination
results.summary: A sync httpx client that fetches and caches an OAuth2 client-credentials token, refreshes it on 401, and follows Link-header pagination, tested offline with respx routes.

results.title: httpx client + tenacity retries with backoff, tested with respx
results.summary: Retry transient HTTP failures (5xx, 429, timeouts) with tenacity around an httpx client, honoring a max attempt count, tested offline with respx.

results.title: Quart async routes tested offline with httpx ASGITransport
results.summary: A Quart app with async JSON bodies and an injected httpx client, exercised fully in-process via httpx.ASGITransport and httpx.MockTransport.

results.title: Starlette routes and middleware tested offline with httpx ASGITransport
results.summary: A Starlette app with BaseHTTPMiddleware and lifespan state, exercised in-process via httpx ASGITransport without a real server.
